_doc: Golden fixture for oracle_verdict event (R9 OracleStack). Default-on since cycle-7 flip 2026-04-29 (commit 128e1b89): emitted when SAGE_ORACLE is unset or any non-kill-switch value; suppressed only by kill-switch values 0/false/off/no/disable/disabled (case-insensitive).
_invariants: MUST be emitted after final_result and before run_frame_summary when SAGE_RUN_FRAME=1 and oracle_enabled() is true
MUST NEVER include raw final output text
MUST NEVER appear when SAGE_ORACLE is 0/false/off/no/disable/disabled (kill-switch)
